B.population: Completed plate appearances in MLB regular-season games that ended on a bunt (sacrifice, bunt hit, bunt out, or strikeout on a foul bunt) with 0 or 1 out, a runner on first and/or second and third base empty. Success = the lead runner (the runner on second if there is one, otherwise the runner on first) ends the play on a later base or scores. Failure = the lead runner is put out or stays.
B.question: Probability that the lead runner advances (success as defined).

league_this_season_before_today.note: rate of earlier dates this season in this population; the previous season's rate until the season has 100 such bunts

B.population: Completed plate appearances in MLB regular-season games in the 7th inning or later with first base empty and a runner on second and/or third. Intentional walks and catcher's interference are excluded. Success = the batter reaches base by a hit, walk or hit by pitch; anything else (including reaching on an error or a fielder's choice) = failure.
B.question: Probability that the batter reaches base (success as defined).
